policy.privacy: Only committed synthetic fixtures or explicitly licensed, provenance-tracked external fixtures may participate. Local clinical paths and PHI are forbidden.
policy.lossless: Canonical stored samples must match exactly; reports identify the first differing sample, component, and frame.
policy.nearLossless: Every reconstructed sample must remain within the explicitly encoded NEAR bound.
policy.lossy: A case must declare its metric and rationale. No universal clinical threshold is inferred by this harness.
policy.metadata: Transfer syntax, encapsulation, pixel description, frame order, and required DICOM geometry remain exact even for lossy pixels.
policy.gaps: Missing licensed fixtures remain visible with a named owner and reason; they are never removed to make a report green.

coverage.gap: No small redistributable MG fixture with verified provenance is committed.
DX behavior has synthetic pixel tests but no committed Part 10 DX fixture.
CR behavior has synthetic pixel tests but no committed Part 10 CR fixture.
The committed US fixture validates multiframe metadata only; a licensed color Doppler pixel fixture is still required.
